limitations: Synthetic restaurants, menus, couriers and payments only; no real brands, menus, people or payment data.
One account holder per App instance; ordering for someone else means ordering from this account.
MCP only: no GUI, no restaurant-facing or courier screens.
Time is the environment's: no clock event and no scheduler. Scheduled releases and the 20-minute acceptance limit are due times on each order, applied from the supplied virtual time.
No attachments or media: resources are not used.
